blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Rodante Marcoleta allegedly “solicited” P20 million from businessman Aristotle Viray, one of the donors linked to the plunder case involving P75-million funds, a witness told the Sandiganbayan on Thursday. Maria Melinda Mananghaya-Henson of the Office of the Ombudsman’s Field Investigation Bureau, who led the fact-finding investigation into the case, made the revelation during the bail petition hearing of Marcoleta and his co-accused, former Rep. Mike Defensor and businessmen Joseph Espiritu and Viray.
